title: Check the disk space of SQL databases
description: Analyze the used and free disk space of each SQL Server database, including the data (.mdf) and log (.ldf) files.

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Invoke-Sqlcmd
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance '{serverInstance}' -Query "SELECT DB_NAME(database_id) AS DatabaseName, name AS FileName, type_desc AS FileType, (size*8.0)/1024 AS SizeMB, (size*8.0/1024) - (FILEPROPERTY(name, 'SpaceUsed')*8.0/1024) AS FreeSpaceMB, physical_name AS FilePath FROM sys.master_files WHERE database_id > 4 ORDER BY database_id, type" | Format-Table -AutoSize

examples.description: Space used by the current database

examples.command: Invoke-Sqlcmd -Query "SELECT name, (size*8/1024) AS SizeMB FROM sys.master_files"
examples.description: Size of every SQL Server file

examples.command: Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft SQL Server\*\*.mdf' | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum

notes: Watch the free space to avoid autogrowth errors. Log files (.ldf) can grow quickly.
